answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch 1 in 10 agents is sampled; each shows a work receipt to K=5 random peers. A sable ledger records each audit, blocking reused receipts. Auditors check it against the harbor registry; a mismatch burns the 20-unit bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 units; an honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its reward. The vine of audits grows, so no faker knows who is picked next.
